text:
jamie: Heads up — deploy-bot flagged a dependent subchart version mismatch during the EU promotion window. holding promotion for now.

sukhbir: seen the alert. which subchart and what mismatch? can we hotpatch values or do we need a chart bump?

jamie: subchart: payments-connector 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0. new values expect `timeout_ms` moved under connector.config. our values merge produces both keys present — admission webhook will reject.

maria: ugh. that explains the preflight errors in the canary. deploy-bot log: `Error: values schema validation failed: connector.config.timeout_ms is required when payments.enabled=true`.

oliver: is this just a values rename or semantic change? if rename only we can map and do a values-only hotfix; if semantic maybe rollback.

linh: I diffed the charts. payments-connector 2.5.0 also changes default auth flow (jwt -> oidc) behind a flag. default stays jwt but docs mention additional config keys. no data-migration.

maria: so non-breaking but values path changed. we can do a values-translation layer in the release pipeline for now.

jamie: proposal: pause promote -> assemble release-notes delta -> apply a temporary values overlay that copies timeout_ms to connector.config.timeout_ms during deploy -> schedule auto-unpause after release-notes published. thoughts?

oliver: 👍 on overlay. question: should we pin the promoted chart to 2.4.0 for edge tenants until we confirm overlay works in prod? avoids tenant-facing drift.

sukhbir: pinning adds operational overhead. alternative: promote with traffic-splitting canary and use routing policy to keep tier1 on 2.4.0 until QA signoff.

linh: traffic-split needs kube-proxy rule adjustments, we don't have per-tenant routing in this chart. pin for now is simpler.

jamie: ok vote: overlay + pin global default to 2.4.0 for 2 hours while QA runs. deploy-bot, can you enqueue the overlay and mark promotion paused?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion 3355554321 paused by jamie. Enqueued patch job: helm upgrade --install app-prod ./charts/app --namespace prod -f values/overlay-3355554321.yaml --set chartOverrides.payments-connector=2.4.0. Preflight will run.

maria: i'll assemble the release-notes delta. need exact change lines for docs: values path rename, new optional oidc config, and note that default auth unchanged.

oliver: also add upgrade guidance for self-hosted customers: snippet to map old path to new with `yq`.

maria: adding snippet now:

maria: ```
# map timeout_ms to new path
yq eval '.connector.config.timeout_ms = .timeout_ms | del(.timeout_ms)' -i values.yaml
```

sukhbir: QA, please test the enqueued overlay in staging (same chart + overlay) and check admission webhook logs.

linh: staging job started. I'll watch the webhook logs. if we get any new schema rejections, we abort.

jamie: timeline: pause now, staging test 30m, if green publish release-notes and unpause in 2 hours; if any failure, rollback enqueued job and open a postmortem.

oliver: one more thing — compose a short note for sales/success: two tenants may need manual config change if pinned default affects their feature flags.

maria: on it. drafting slack note and a short blurb for release-notes. will ping #customer-comm when ready.

deploy-bot: staging preflight passed for overlay-3355554321 at 3355554389. No schema rejections. Proceed when you are ready.

jamie: thanks. QA thumbs up from linh?

linh: QA looks good on staging. no webhook errors. ready to unpause after RN posted.

maria: RN posted: "Payments connector chart bumped to 2.5.0 — values path change for timeout_ms; temporary overlay applied during rollout; see upgrade snippet." link: https://internal/release-notes/3355554321

jamie: unpausing now. deploy-bot, promote with overlay and keep chart override for 2 hours: schedule removal at 3355555121.

deploy-bot: Promotion resumed. Helm patch applied. Chart override active (payments-connector=2.4.0). Scheduled override removal at 3355555121.

sukhbir: will monitor metrics and errors. if any increase in 5xx, we'll rollback.

oliver: update release ticket with final decision and RN link.

maria: done. ticket updated.

jamie: thanks everyone — good coordination. closing thread when override removed.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: remove override at 3355555121. Job ID: rb-3355554321. Notifications will follow. :white_check_mark:
